glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 言 (“to say”) + phonetic 𧶠.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 讀 (言 → 讠 and 賣 → 卖).
senses: [dú] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to say aloud; to tell
[dòu] short pause in reading; part of a sentence; clause
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 讀; s_page_origin explains the simplified 读.
